messages:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] High alert volume detected: redis-cluster-3 timeouts increased x80 in 2m. PagerDuty: page-eng-oncall. Link: https://console.redwood.dev/d/alerts/redis-cluster?orgId=1 :rotating_light:
Leah (oncall): on it. I'm joining the prod channel. Starting triage — can someone confirm customer impact?
Ravi: I'm seeing spikes in 5xxs for the streaming gateway proxied to redis, roughly 2.2k errors/min. A handful of API keys showing retries.
Sam: I can confirm increased latencies on qps-frontend in US-east. Looks like prefix KV cache misses also spiked.
Leah (oncall): ok, action plan: 1) mute noisy alert rule to stop PD churn, 2) add temporary grouping/dedupe in PD for redis timeout alerts, 3) create a short-term rate-limit/squelch in our alert router so only P1 pages, 4) handoff to Ravi for live mitigation.
Zoe: +1. For (1) we should do a targeted squelch, not global. I'll create a dedupe rule on PD for "redis-cluster-3 timeout" keyed on cluster+region.
Alex (sre): Also recommend adding a quick grafana panel: last 5m error rate per host and recent GC pauses. Pasting a quick query we can add to the dashboard:
```
sum by (host) (increase(redis_timeouts_total[5m]))
```
Leah (oncall): doing the squelch now.
Leah (oncall): /pd-squelch add --service "redis-alerts" --condition "redis-cluster-3" --duration 30m --note "live mitigation: reduce noise while we investigate"
incidents-bot: actions: PagerDuty squelch created (30m) by Leah.
Sam: Confirmed PD surge stopped, pages reduced. Still seeing error spike on hosts 10-14.
Ravi: I'm going to scale the redis read pool by +2 replicas and enable local ttl cache on the service to reduce KV pressure. Applying now.
Leah (oncall): before scaling, we should deploy a short-term fallback: route non-critical traffic to stale-cache mode. Sam, can your team flip the env var?
Sam: yeah. Pushing a config change to deploy to us-east only:
```
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/gateway CACHE_STALE_FALLBACK=true --record
```
Sam: rolled. Error rate dropped about 30% in the next 90s.
Zoe: I'm drafting a short-term alert-tuning ticket: lower sensitivity of redis-timeouts from 3m -> 10m aggregation to avoid spikes. Also propose grouping key as cluster+region+service.
Leah (oncall): good. For PD dedupe: Zoe + Alex, can you capture exact matcher rules? Put snippet here so we can copy into PD runbook.
Zoe: copied matcher draft:
```
- match: "alertname: RedisTimeout"
  group_by: ["cluster", "region", "service"]
  dedupe_window: 300s
  threshold: 10
```
Alex (sre): looks good. I'll add a rate-limit in our alert-router to suppress repeat alerts from a host exceeding 5x in 1m into a single aggregated event. Implementation sketch:
```
alert-router config:
  dedupe:
    window: 60s
    max_per_key: 1
    key: cluster:host:alertname
```
Ravi: scaling completed; replicas +2. Redis eviction rate lowered and p99 latency improved.
Leah (oncall): thanks. We're good to de-escalate. I'm going to hand this to Ravi for the next hour to monitor.
Leah (oncall): Follow-ups: (A) file infra ticket to change alert aggregation to 10m for redis timeouts (owner: Zoe), (B) PD runbook update with dedupe rules (owner: Alex), (C) add dashboard panel for host-level timeouts (owner: Sam).
Zoe: creating ticket INFRA-5943: "Tune redis timeout alerts + PD grouping" and adding urgency and rollback notes.
Alex (sre): I'll update the runbook and add the alert-router patch to a PR with changelog.
Ravi: monitoring metrics. If error rate remains <200/min for 15m, I'll close the active incident and mark no widespread customer impact.
Leah (oncall): handing off to @Ravi now — I'm off for handoffs. Leave any new noise in this thread. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Handoff recorded: Leah -> Ravi. Next oncall window updated.
Ravi: taking over. I'll keep an eye for 30m and will escalate if it regresses.
Sam: nice job team. One suggestion: let's add a small post-incident doc with exact alert thresholds we changed so product teams know why they saw fewer pages. I'll draft a short note.
Leah (oncall): agreed. Sam, add to #postmortems or link doc.
Zoe: adding dashboard link and PR links here once created.
Alex (sre): +1 — and we should run a sim in staging to validate dedupe/routing behavior. I'll schedule that.
Leah (oncall): closing the active page for now. Great job everyone.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT: resolved (provisional). Closed by Leah.
Ravi: provisional close verified — p99 latency back to baseline. Will mark resolved in 30m if stable.
